title: Introduce backoff-correlation header and idempotency session for multiplexed streamed tool responses
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Multiplexed streamed tool responses (concurrent tool/function frames over a single stream) expose ambiguous retry semantics when transient server-side limits (rate windows, backend queueing, intermittent failures) occur. Clients today either retry the entire stream (risking duplicate tool executions) or avoid retrying (losing availability). This PR introduces two coordinated mechanisms to make retries safe and observable: 1) a backoff-correlation header that ties retry windows across multiplexed frames so clients can make informed backoff decisions without duplicating work, and 2) an Idempotency-Session token that scopes deduplication information for tool/function calls that may span multiple stream frames. At a glance: - API surface: adds "X-Backoff-Correlation" and "Idempotency-Session" headers, and extends the stream error envelope with structured fields {"error_code","backoff_hint_ms","correlation_id"}. - Behavior: servers may include X-Backoff-Correlation on 429/503 error frames (or initial connection response) to indicate a correlated backoff window. Clients should treat backoff_hint_ms as advisory; presence of correlation_id supports aggregated backoff strategies across concurrently-open streams. Idempotency-Session is a server-issued opaque token returned when a client marks a request as idempotent; it scopes server-side dedupe caches and prevents duplicate tool executions across reconnects and stream splits. - Compatibility: OpenAI-compat shim maps Retry-After and standard 429/503 behaviors to the new envelope; existing idempotency-key behavior is preserved for single-request flows. - Safety: tool executions are gated by (idempotency_key, idempotency_session) tuples; when Idempotency-Session is present, the server will persist dedupe state for the session duration (configurable, default 5 minutes). - Observability: added metrics: stream.backoff.correlation_count, stream.idemp_session.created, stream.idemp_session.dedup_hit. - Migration notes: SDKs clients should prefer exponential backoff with jitter but also consult backoff_hint_ms and correlation_id to coordinate across connections. The PR includes server, openai-compat shim, and SDK tests. Checklist: - [x] API changes implemented in stream framing code - [x] openai-compat mapping updated - [x] gated server-side dedupe store with TTL and eviction policy - [x] unit + integration tests for reconnect/dedup scenarios - [x] docs and upgrade notes - [x] e2e perf regression <5% on p99 latency (benchmark-run attached) Commits summary: - 7a2b9c3 Add backoff-correlation header parsing and propagation in stream runtime - c1d4f10 Introduce idempotency-session token lifecycle and server dedupe store - f5e8a91 Map new envelope into openai-compat shim and maintain existing idempotency-key semantics - b2c2d44 Add unit tests for dedup across reconnects, and integration test for multiplexed backoff - d8e9a77 Docs: API reference + upgrade notes + migration guide Changed areas/files (high level): - runtime/streaming/stream_protocol.go: parse/serialize new envelope fields and headers - server/idempotency/session_store.go: implement TTL + eviction + persistence hooks - openai-compat/adapter/stream_mapper.go: map 429/503 and Retry-After into structured envelope - sdk/js/stream-client.ts: honor X-Backoff-Correlation and Idempotency-Session, add client-side coordination helper - docs/api/streaming.md: documented new headers and error envelope - tests/integration/stream_backoff_dedup_test.go: e2e scenarios and assertions Small illustrative snippet (proto-like envelope used in the stream frames): {"type":"error","error":{"error_code":"rate_limit.correlated","message":"temporary capacity pressure","backoff_hint_ms":4500,"correlation_id":"bc-7a3f"}} Review summary and motivation are inlined in the PR description below.

release_notes: Added X-Backoff-Correlation and Idempotency-Session headers for streamed tool responses; servers emit structured error envelopes with error_code and backoff_hint_ms. This enables correlated backoff across multiplexed streams and safe deduplication of tool calls during reconnects. SDKs updated to honor new headers. No breaking changes for single-request idempotency-key flows.
merge_decision_notes: After two rounds of review (nits addressed) and performance verification on benchmark-lab, the change was merged to main via squash. Migration docs added to reduce customer friction. Flagged for follow-up: ENG-3301 to evaluate long-term TTL tuning and cross-region session propagation.
